--print-contract-version.note: Prints the published JSON Schema contract version whose stability is governed by this requirement.

--descriptor.note: Flag specifies path to interface descriptor YAML that framework accepts
Descriptors are derived from contracts and supplied via this path
Framework loads both service and tool descriptor archetypes via this path
Supplies the interface descriptor the framework must accept and load.
Provides the descriptor read by CLI-augmented scenario generation.

--mode.note: Selects one of three generation modes: template-only, cli-augmented, sdk-only
Selects among the required template-only, CLI-augmented, and SDK-only generation modes.
Selects the execution mode whose time or USD budget semantics apply.

--cli-command.note: Configures CLI tool for cli-augmented mode scenario generation
Configures the CLI tool used for CLI-augmented scenario generation.

--time-budget.note: Enforces configurable time budget in minutes for CLI-augmented mode
Sets the configurable wall-clock budget for CLI-augmented mode.

--sdk-budget.note: Enforces configurable USD budget cap for SDK-only mode
Sets the configurable USD cap for SDK-based execution.

--max-iterations.note: Configures iterations with feedback flowing from evaluator to next generation
Orchestrator manages lifecycle with configurable gen-eval iteration count
Configures the number of generator-evaluator feedback iterations.

--parallel.note: Configures asyncio.Semaphore concurrency limit for parallel scenario execution
Sets the concurrency limit for parallel scenario execution.

--changed-features-ref.note: Enables generator to produce targeted scenarios for changed features
Orchestrator detects changed features via git diff against this ref
Provides the change reference used to target scenarios at changed features.
Provides the Git ref used for changed-feature detection and filtering.
Supports progressive scope allocation beginning with changed features.

--categories.note: Scenarios support category tags for filtering and budget allocation
Generator accepts focus areas including categories for targeted scenario production
Selects category focus areas for targeted scenario generation.
Filters scenarios using their required category metadata.

--report-format.note: Orchestrator produces structured reports in markdown, JSON, or both formats
Selects the structured report representation produced by the orchestrator.

--output-dir.note: Orchestrator outputs reports to specified directory
Configures where the orchestrator writes its reports.

--no-services.note: Skips service startup and teardown in orchestrator lifecycle
Service lifecycle configuration is optional; flag allows bypassing it
Configures execution when service lifecycle management is skipped or services are already running.
Alters the service startup and teardown portions of the orchestrated lifecycle.

--fail-threshold.note: Framework provides configurable pass-rate threshold to exit 0

--min-coverage.note: Framework provides configurable coverage threshold that fails run when interface coverage falls below it
Enforces minimum 80%+ interface coverage for service dogfood descriptors
Sets the independent interface-coverage threshold that can fail a run.
Uses the reported interface coverage percentage as a gating metric.

--openspec-change.note: Change-id augments cli-augmented prompt with Requirement+Scenario blocks
Active change's spec delta takes precedence in requirement resolution
Active change must be named explicitly to gate for scoped validation
Gate derives change-id from paths and invokes sweep with --change flag
Supplies an OpenSpec change whose requirement and scenario blocks constrain CLI-augmented scenario generation.
